entry.title: 4.12.27 - QuickExport is now a Blender extension
entry.content:
• New (Blender): QuickExport now installs as a Blender extension instead of a legacy add-on. Install it from Get Extensions with Install from Disk, and Blender manages its folder from then on.
  • Improved (Blender): Update now installs new versions through Blender's extension system and restarts Blender. Updating an older add-on install from version 4.12.25 or later switches it to the extension in one click and keeps your preferences and shortcut.

entry.title: 4.12.17 - Check for Update finds the right build on Linux and macOS
entry.content: • Fixed (Blender): On Linux and macOS, Check for Update now offers the release built for your system instead of the Windows one.

entry.title: 4.12.16 - Displaced meshes keep their shape and render faster in Maya
entry.content: • Fixed (Maya): Meshes with true displacement no longer get four extra subdivision levels in Arnold. They now use the Subdivision Surface modifier's viewport level, or no subdivision when there is none, so their shape matches Cycles and heavy meshes render much faster with far less GPU memory.

entry.title: 4.12.11 - Scenes with Geometry Nodes scatters transfer to Maya again
entry.content:
• Fixed (Blender): Exporting a scene that contains a Geometry Nodes scatter to Maya no longer fails partway through. Scattered pieces now follow their object's Viewport Display As setting, so a Bounds or Wire scatter object draws the same way in Maya.
  • Improved (Blender): A display or subdivision hint that can't be read, such as conflicting subdivision scheme custom properties, no longer stops the export. That one setting is skipped and listed in a warning, and everything else transfers as usual.

entry.title: 4.12.10 - Strongly distorted noise matches Blender more closely
entry.content: • Improved (Maya): Noise Textures with a Distortion above 0.5 no longer come out over-distorted in Arnold, so their warp and fine detail stay closer to Blender. Lower Distortion values look the same as before, and the network is still a single noise node.

entry.title: 4.12.9 - Rough noise keeps its grain in Maya
entry.content: • Improved (Maya): Noise Textures with high Roughness now keep their fine grain in Arnold instead of turning into soft, blurry blobs. The large shapes come out a little smaller, and the network is still a single noise node.

entry.title: 4.12.8 - AI assistants can carry views between ZBrush, Blender and Maya
entry.content: • New (Blender, Maya): AI assistants can now turn the current ZBrush view into a Blender or Maya camera that sees the model the same way, including perspective, focal length and orthographic views. It works the other way too: a Blender or Maya camera can set the ZBrush view, so you can sculpt from the exact shot you are rendering.

entry.title: 4.12.7 - AI assistants can frame and capture the ZBrush view
entry.content: • New (Blender): AI assistants working with ZBrush can now read and change the view: rotate, move and zoom the model, switch perspective, set the focal length or field of view, and frame either all visible SubTools or just the active one. They can also capture the current ZBrush view as an image to check their work.

entry.title: 4.12.6 - AI assistants can work with ZBrush
entry.content: • New (Blender): AI assistants using QuickExport's MCP server can now start ZBrush in the background, list its SubTools with their point and face counts, and move sculpts between Blender and ZBrush in both directions. Each import shows what it will add or replace first and reports exactly which SubTools were added, replaced or removed. ZBrush runs one copy at a time, so close ZBrush before an assistant starts it; connecting to an open ZBrush is not supported yet.

entry.title: 4.12.5 - Review exports with a hidden camera
entry.content:
• Fixed (Blender): AI-assisted review transfers now export when the scene camera or a light is hidden in the viewport, so the reviewed camera arrives in Maya.
  • Improved (Blender): AI-assisted selection now reports objects Blender could not select because they are hidden or locked.

entry.title: 4.12.4 - Connect MCP button visible in Maya settings
entry.content: • Fixed (Maya): The Connect MCP and Disconnect MCP buttons in Quick Export Settings > Advanced were hidden behind Save Settings. They now show at the bottom of Advanced with the connection status on its own line, and the settings window is a bit more compact.

entry.title: 4.12.3 - Reinstall the ZBrush side with ZBrush open
entry.content: • Fixed (Blender): Install ZBrush Side no longer fails while ZBrush is running and its QuickExport files are unchanged. If a changed file is in use, the error now tells you to close ZBrush instead of wrongly blaming the ZBrush 2026.0 startup folder.

entry.title: 4.12.2 - ZBrush 2026.0 install asks for administrator permission
entry.content: • Improved (Blender): Install ZBrush Side on ZBrush 2026.0 now shows the Windows administrator prompt when ZBrush's startup file can't be changed, instead of stopping with an error. Accept it once and the install finishes; ZBrush 2026.1+ never needs it.

entry.title: 4.12.1 - Python scripts from AI assistants in Blender
entry.content: • New (Blender): AI assistants connected to Blender with Connect MCP can now run a Python script when the built-in actions don't cover what they need, just like in Maya. They get the printed output and any error back, see which objects and meshes the script added or removed, can stop a long script, and in an open Blender each script is a single Ctrl+Z step.

entry.title: 4.12.0 - QuickExport 4.12
entry.content: • Improved (Blender, Maya): QuickExport moves to the 4.12 release line. This version has the same features and fixes as 4.11.597; update both Blender and Maya to 4.12.0 so they stay in step.

entry.title: 4.11.597 - Faster Maya Rigged exports
entry.content: • Fixed (Blender): Maya Rigged (Editable Rig) exports no longer load every image in the file each time. In scenes with many large textures, exporting a rig or a single object now takes about a second instead of several, and textures the export doesn't use stay unloaded.

entry.title: 4.11.596 - Display As carries over to Maya
entry.content: • New (Maya): Objects set to Display As Bounds or Wire in Blender (Object Properties > Viewport Display) now show the same way in Maya: as a bounding box or as wireframe. Maya only draws box bounds, so Sphere, Cylinder, Cone and Capsule bounds become a box, with a note in the import warnings.

entry.title: 4.11.595 - Bug reports from AI assistants
entry.content: • New (Blender): AI assistants connected to Blender through the QuickExport MCP server can now prepare a bug report the same way the Send Report button does, attach their renders, logs and transfer files, and show you exactly what is inside before anything is sent. Nothing is uploaded until it is explicitly submitted, and an interrupted upload picks up where it stopped.

entry.title: 4.11.594 - ZBrush side for every version
entry.content: • Improved (Blender): Install ZBrush Side now installs QuickExport into every ZBrush 2026+ on your machine, not just the newest. A version it can't install into (never opened yet, or 2026.0 without admin rights) is skipped with a note saying why, and the others still install.

entry.title: 4.11.593 - ZBrush install fix
entry.content: • Fixed (Blender): Install ZBrush Side works when more than one ZBrush version is installed: it picks the asset folder that belongs to the ZBrush it installs into
